C) HOWEVER, FIRM(S) INTERESTED TO BE REGISTERED AS A SELLER TO SAIL, SHOULD FILL THE VE NDOR REGISTRATION FORM HOSTED ON THE SAIL TENDERS WEBSITE (WWW.SAILTENDERS.CO.IN) AND COMPLETE THE DUE PROCESS OF REGISTRATION WITH SAIL PLANTS/UNITS. THE STANDARD REGISTRATION PROCESS OF SAIL-RSP SHALL THEN BE FOLLOWED TO ASSESS AND REGISTER ELIG IBLE SUPPLIERS. D) THIS INFORMATION IS PROVIDED SOLELY TO EXPLORE THE POSSIBILITY OF EXPANDING THE VE NDOR BASE, WHERE REQUIRED, AND SHOULD NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A PURCHASE ENQUIRY. FU TURE PURCHASE ENQUIRIES MAY BE ISSUED TO SUCH SUPPLIERS IF THEY ARE SUCCESSFULLY REG ISTERED. REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION: - REAGENT FOR BIOCHEMISTRY DEPTT. FOR AU5800 (2026-27). SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS: - A) SHELF LIFE: THE LEFT-OVER SHELF LIFE OF THE ITEM/ITEMS AT THE TIME OF RECEIPT SHOULD B E AT LEAST 80% OR MORE. B) THE TENDERER MUST ACCEPT TENDERED SPECIFICATION. OFFERS NOT CONFORMING TO TEND ERED SPECIFICATION SHALL BE SUMMARILY REJECTED. C) THE MATERIAL AT THE TIME OF SUPPLY SHOULD CONTAIN THE FOLLOWING DOCUMENTS: - I)GUARANTY CERTIFICATE

ii)THE TAX INVOICE CONTAINING THE DETAILS OF THE SUPPLIED MATERIAL SUCH AS BATCH NO , MANUFACTURING DATE AND EXPIRY DATE. D) THE QUANTITY REQUIRED SHOWN IN THE TENDER IS FOR NO OF TESTS. FARM TO QUOTE PRICE FOR EACH TEST. E) HOD BIOCHEMISTRY OR THEIR REPRESENTATIVE WILL INPECT THE MATERIAL. F) THE REAGENTS ARE TO BE USED IN AU5800 AUTO ANANLYZER; HENCE VENDORS MUST ENSUR E THE COMPATIBILITY OF REAGENTS FOR THIS EQUIPMENT. G) THE VENDOR WHILE QUOTING MUST PROVIDE THE PRODUCT DETAILS ALONG WITH PROGRAM ME SHEET FOR AU5800/DXC-700 FROM THE MANUFACTURER TO JUSTIFY THE NUMBER OF TESTS I N THIS MACHINE.FALLING TO DO SO WILL BE LIABLE FOR REJECTION.THE PRODUCTS OF M/S AFFE GENIX /BIOGENESIS HEALTHCARE/DIASYS/BECKMAN COULTER/BIOSYSTEM/ KOPRAN LABORATORIE S LTD MAKE ONLY ACCEPTABLE. H) THE REAGENT SHOULD BE LIQUID STABLE SYSTEM PACK FOR AU5800 & DXC-700. I) VENDER MUST BE THE MANUFACTURER ONLY. IN CASE THE MANUFACTURER DOES NOT HAVE D IRECT PRESENCE IN INDIA; THE SOUL AUTHORIZED IN INDIA SHOULD QUOTE. J) ACCORDING TO PACK SIZE WE MAY ACCEPT 40% EXTRA OR 20% LESS QUANTITY OF THE INDEN TED QUANTITY. K) AFTER PLACEMENT OF ORDER THE PACK SIZE OF THE ORDERED ITEMS CAN NOT BE CHANGED. L) EUROPEAN CE CERTIFICATION DOCUMENT MUST BE PROVIDED AT THE TIME OF RFQ & BEFORE BULK SUPPLY. M) THE VENDOR MUST SPECIFY THE FREQUENCY OF CALIBRATION FOR THE TEST IN SAID MACHIN E AND SHOULD SUPPLY CALIBRATORS AND CONTROLS REQUIRED FOR THE SPECIFIC TESTS ALON G WITH REAGENTS.THE PRICE SHOULD BE INCLUSIVE OF ALL REAGENTS, CALIBRATOR AND CONT ROLL TAKEN ALL TOGETHER. DELIVERY REQUIREMENT: - DELIVERY WITH IN TWO INSTALLEMENTS (I.E 1ST WITH IN 60 DAYS AND 2ND FROM 120 TO 180 D AYS AFTER PO PLACEMENT) AS PER THE REQUIREMENT FROM THE USER SECTION OF MEDICAL DE PARTMENT. GUARANTEE CLAUSE: - A) THE SUPPLIER MUST REPLACE THE MATERIAL WHICH DOES NOT CONFORM TO ORDERED SPECIFICATION OR IT IS FOUND TO BE OF SUBSTANDARD QUALITY OR HAVING ANY MANUFACTURI NG DEFECT, WITHIN THE EXPIRY DATE. MATERIAL IS TO BE REPLACED FREE OF CHARGE ON F.O.R I GH-MM-STORES SHALL BE BORNE BY SUPPLIER. B) GURANTEE CERTIFICATE IS TO BE FURNISHED ALONG WITH THE MATERIAL SUPPLIED TO THE PL ANT. PRICE VARIATION CLAUSE: - PRICES MUST REMAIN FIRM DURING THE CURRENCY OF THE CONTRACT.

PACKING CLAUSE: - A) 'IGH /SAIL HOSPITAL USE ONLY/HOSPITAL SUPPLY NOT FOR SALE/GOVT.SUPPLY NOT FOR SALE'/ ESI HOSPITAL SUPPLY TO BE EMBOSSED/MARKED OR STAMPED ON EACH STRIPS/AMPS/BOTTLES & ON PACKING. B) TABLET/ CAPSULES/INJECTIONS ETC. IN STRIPS/PACKET AND PACKED IN BOXES, WHICH SHOUL D BE PROPERLY SEALED OR TAPED. C) THE SUPPLIER IS ALSO RESPONSIBLE FOR SUITABLE PRESERVATION SUCH AS MAINTAINING COLD CHAIN TO AVOID DETERIORATION DURING TRANSIT OR AS THE CASE MAY BE. INSPECTION AGENCY: - HOD BIOCHEMISTRY OR THEIR REPRESANTATIVE. INSPECTION TERMS: - THE TENDERER MUST SUPPLY ACCORDING TO THE TENDERED SPECIFICATION. MATERIALS NOT CO NFORMING TO THE TENDERED SPECIFICATIONS SHALL BE SUMMARILY REJECTED AT THE TIME OF I NSPECTION. PLACE OF INSPECTION: - AT RSP, IGH (MM) RECEIPT STORE. PR - 2675000079 . 5.
